label: FP
reason: The XSS sinks (println statements) concatenate user-displayed values, but tracing the data flow reveals these values do NOT originate from user input. 'user' is derived from class name (safe constant), and 'rememberMeKey' comes from SecureRandom.nextInt() - neither allows user-controlled payloads.

evidence.note: XSS sinks print user and rememberMeKey, but both are derived from secure constants (class name, SecureRandom) not user input
